subject: Usage signal & budget gating for inference API
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@metaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Usage signal & budget gating for inference API

Alex — great to speak earlier. Quick written recap and a couple of asks so we can put a concrete hosting proposal together for MetaFlow.

Call highlights (quick):
- Primary flow: user chat + summarization post-chat. Average prompt length ~350 tokens, responses ~700 tokens.
- Latency SLO: 300–600ms P95 for chat traffic; some async batch summarization acceptable at higher latency.
- Two traffic shapes: steady baseline (~2–5 TPS) with short business-hour bursts.

Key ask for pricing qualification (please confirm the numbers below or correct them):
1) Expected committed monthly token volume (initial 6–12 months): ?
2) Typical steady-state TPS and absolute peak TPS (10–15 minute burst windows): ?
3) Budget range you’re targeting for infra + API per month (ballpark): ?
4) Target $/1M tokens you’d need us to hit to make this commit likely: ?

I attached our pricing slab and a small sample CSV to make the usage-shaped numbers easy to populate. If you can fill the CSV with a rough month-by-hour profile we’ll run a quick cost-sensitivity and present 2-3 slab options (committed vs flexible) that protect you from peak-surge exposure.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the three numbers above (tokens / peak TPS / budget).
- I run cost scenarios + recommended slab (we’ll include burst credits and a safety cap for short TPS spikes).
- Internal pricing sync (I’ll loop in Marissa + Jonas) and a follow-up call next week.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-slab.pdf, metaflow-usage-sample.csv, mutual-action-plan.docx

Thanks — appreciate the time today.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Alex Geller <alex.geller@metaflow.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@metaflow.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 12:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage signal & budget gating for inference API

Soojin — thanks for the summary, that matches our internal notes closely. Answers below, happy to clarify further.

1) Expected monthly tokens (first 6 months): 6,000,000 — 9,000,000 tokens/month. We plan a product beta in June and expect ramp across Q3; numbers above are conservative for initial committed slab.

2) TPS shape: steady-state ~3–6 TPS. We see frequent short bursts during peak business hours. Typical short burst profile: baseline -> spike to ~45 TPS for 5–10 minutes; rare events (up to 120 TPS) could occur for ~5–10 mins during heavy campaign tests. We need a safety cap for those windows — 10 minute burst tolerance is critical.

3) Budget range: $8,000 — $12,000 / month for hosted inference + API. This needs to cover tokens + predictable latency without wild overage risk.

4) Target $/1M tokens: roughly $1,333 per 1M tokens (that’s what maps to the budget above given the token expectation). We know that’s aggressive — open to options like a committed discount slab vs higher overage price.

Procurement note: procurement@metaflow.ai will require a short SOW and an invoice schedule (Net30). If we move forward, they’ll ask for SOC2 certification + a sample DPA. We can loop them into a short procurement call once pricing is locked.

—
Alex Geller
Head of Platform | MetaFlow AI
alex.geller@metaflow.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@metaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage signal & budget gating for inference API

Alex — perfect, this is super helpful and gives us a clear starting point. Short response with how we’ll proceed and two immediate options to evaluate:

Quick analysis notes (based on your inputs):
- At 6–9M tokens/mo and target $1,333/1M, implied monthly spend sits $8k–$12k (aligned).
- Peak tolerance (120 TPS for ~5–10 mins) is significant — we’ll design a slab with burst credits and a short-duration burst safety-net (automatic fallback to a cheaper, compatible model variant if sustained beyond 10 minutes).

Two options we’ll price and present tomorrow:
A) Committed slab (3–6 month): price to hit ~$1,333/1M with 10% reserved burst credits. Lower overage rate but requires a minimum monthly commit.
B) Flexible slab + peak protection: higher per-1M baseline, automatic short-burst credit pool, and an add-on for guaranteed P95 latency (SLA). This gives you ops-level safety without a heavy commit.

Next steps (concrete):
- I’ll run the scenario models and send a side-by-side (pricing + expected token burn + worst-case monthly overage) by EOD tomorrow.
- Internal pricing sync scheduled Tuesday 9am PT (Marissa, Jonas, me) to confirm margins and options.
- If either option looks good, we’ll prepare a short LOI + SOW for procurement to review (I’ll include SOC2/DPA links).

Can you confirm whether MetaFlow can do a 3-month committed slab if the price hits your target? If not, we’ll lean on option B and tune the burst credits.

Thanks — we’ll follow up with a formal comparison tomorrow.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: updated-mutual-action-plan.docx
